agent_functions_scope_binding_check.name: agent_functions_scope_binding_check
agent_functions_scope_binding_check.value:
("agent_function_definitions"."scope" = 'product' AND "agent_function_definitions"."owner_id" IS NULL AND "agent_function_definitions"."project_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("agent_function_definitions"."scope" = 'owner' AND "agent_function_definitions"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_function_definitions"."project_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("agent_function_definitions"."scope" = 'project' AND "agent_function_definitions"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_function_definitions"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

behavior_patterns_scope_binding_check.name: behavior_patterns_scope_binding_check
behavior_patterns_scope_binding_check.value:
("behavior_patterns"."scope" = 'product' AND "behavior_patterns"."owner_id" IS NULL AND "behavior_patterns"."project_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("behavior_patterns"."scope" = 'owner' AND "behavior_patterns"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "behavior_patterns"."project_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("behavior_patterns"."scope" = 'project' AND "behavior_patterns"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "behavior_patterns"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

project_usage_limits_cost_check.name: project_usage_limits_cost_check
project_usage_limits_cost_check.value:
("project_usage_limits"."max_cost_amount" IS NULL AND "project_usage_limits"."currency" IS NULL)
          OR ("project_usage_limits"."max_cost_amount" > 0 AND "project_usage_limits"."currency" IN ('USD', 'RUB'))
